title: Mastercard pricing - ~1.70-1.80% average interchange plus a growing list of network fees
clean_text: Mastercard interchange fees are set by Mastercard and non-negotiable; US merchants pay an average interchange fee of about 1.80% overall, with in-person payments averaging roughly 1.70%. Mastercard updates rates each April and October. Effective April 2026, Mastercard raised its Undefined Authorization Fee to 0.30% (5 cent minimum), set a Digital Enablement Fee minimum of $0.025 for transactions under $100, introduced a new Fallback Avoidance fee and a Force Post Transaction Fee of 9 cents, and added a $1,000 annual fee for merchants in its Specialty Merchant Registration program.
